title: TREK
name: trek
description: Trip planner for working out each day of a holiday on a map, with bookings, budgets, packing lists and live editing with whoever's coming along. Source: https://github.com/liketrek/TREK

env.name: COOKIE_SECURE
env.label: Opening it over plain http?
env.description: TREK only sends its login cookie over HTTPS unless this is on. Switch it off once it's behind a reverse proxy with HTTPS.

env.name: TZ
env.label: Timezone
env.description: Like Europe/London. Reminders and scheduled jobs run on it.

note: Open http://<your-host>:8099 and sign in as admin@trek.local. The password's printed in the container's logs on first start (search them for First Run), and TREK makes you pick a new one straight away. Anyone who can reach it can register their own account, so switch off Password Registration under Administration --> Settings if that's not what you want. Place search asks TREK's own places.liketrek.com as well as OpenStreetMap, add a TREK_PLACES_ENABLED=false env to keep it to OpenStreetMap. The database, its encryption key and every upload live in the two volumes. Docs: github.com/liketrek/TREK/wiki
